6.7
Vector Database Result
The generated vectors are stored inside a FAISS vector database.
Independent indexes are maintained for each workspace, allowing efficient similarity
search even when multiple users are working simultaneously.
The indexing process completed successfully for all uploaded documents.
6.8
Semantic Search Result
When a user submits a research question, the retrieval engine generates an embedding
for the query and searches the FAISS database.
The system successfully retrieves the most relevant chunks according to cosine simi-
larity.
The retrieved chunks form the contextual knowledge supplied to the Large Language
Model.
6.9
RAG Response Result
The Retrieval-Augmented Generation pipeline successfully generated grounded responses
using only the retrieved document context.
The implemented prompt builder effectively reduced hallucinations by preventing the
language model from using external knowledge.
